analyticalQuestion: Can the R0.31 all-order analytic solution be recentered by one explicit nonzero short step while preserving strict orbit geometry, controlling every omitted degree, and separating the infinite-dimensional enclosure from finite exact regression checks?
supportedClaim: For rho*=4/81, centre c=(rho*/7,-rho*/7), inner radius r=rho*/7, and outer radius R=5rho*/7, the outer local bidisc and the affine orbit of the inner bidisc lie strictly inside the R0.31 domain. Translation conjugacy reduces the nonlinear Lipschitz estimate to the origin with radius ratio 1/2 and constant 121/48. A degree-40 exact GMP reconstruction plus the R0.31 all-order coefficient majorant gives outer-tail bound 1.8052321653651680135e-08, inner inclusion radius 9.899006633275135561e-29, and all-order residual upper bound 5.3934097613896530405e-08. The 42-dimensional exact Jacobian inverse is finite regression evidence only.

qa.notes: The PDF page is exactly 178 by 84 mm and the 600 dpi PNG is 4204 by 1984 pixels. Color, true grayscale, and a 150 dpi Poppler render of the PDF were inspected.
